subject: 40B Comprehensive Permit Fellsway Project Linkage
overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals reviewed draft conditions and waivers for a 289-unit Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application by The Davis Companies along the Fellsway. The board determined that market-rate units in the development are subject to the city's linkage ordinance, heard a presentation on proposed project benefits and mitigations, and voted to continue the hearing to May 30, 2024.

items.title: Chapter 40B Comprehensive Permit: The Davis Companies (Fellsway)
items.summary: Special Counsel Paul Haverty and Building Commissioner Scott Vandewalle reviewed proposed revisions to draft decision conditions, parking, and construction timelines with the applicant's counsel.

items.title: Linkage Ordinance Applicability and Determination
items.summary: The board voted that the market-rate units of the project are subject to Medford's linkage ordinance while reserving the right to credit eligible public improvements against the fee.

items.title: Public Benefits Summary and Continuance
items.summary: The applicant presented an overview of proposed community mitigations, and the board voted to continue the hearing to May 30, 2024.

items.title: Administrative Items
items.summary: Staff noted upcoming coordination meetings with public works and deferred pending meeting minutes to the next session.
